Compare final implementation, preexisting behavior, new required cases, unseen postfreeze inputs and independent architecture or comment evidence. Show results for both repetitions and both subjects. Waiting and blocked states are not completed native handoffs.

Judge whether the single short task instruction has a reproducible completion advantage over standard plus checklist. Do not treat correlated checks as independent trials or an isolated missed point as a new host defect.
